opening.argument: The promotion pairs an extraordinary earning claim of 1400 ETH with an exclusive referral programme, making the offer dependent on recruitment rather than presenting an ordinary product announcement. The speaker reinforces that recruitment-oriented pitch by telling viewers, "if you are not in for Sarge you need to get in," while describing the card as having "an exclusive referral programme." The urgency is coupled with a paid entry point: viewers are told to "pre-order now prices start from 150 dollars." Presented as a lifetime opportunity and accompanied by repeated calls to join and become active, the promotion directs viewers into the Forsage ecosystem through referral participation and a $150 pre-order card.
